Page Structure & Content:
- Admin Top/Breadcrumb Header:
  - Breadcrumbs: Admin > Catalog > Courses > Advanced Excel Masterclass > Curriculum
  - 'Back to courses' link with back chevron
  - Course title: 'Advanced Excel Masterclass' with status pill: 'Draft' (amber/warning pill or slate outline) and 'v2.4' version tag
  - Top action bar: 'Preview as student' outlined button with external eye icon, and indigo primary 'Publish changes' button with check/upload icon.

- Two-Column Layout (60% Left, 40% Right):
  LEFT COLUMN (60% width - Curriculum Section & Lesson Hierarchy):
  - Action row: Quick search / filter lessons, collapse/expand all button, and overall course summary: '4 sections • 26 lessons • 18h 45m total'.
  - Section 1: 'Excel Fundamentals' (Expanded state):
    - Section header: Drag handle icon (6 dots / grip-vertical), section title input/label 'Section 1: Excel Fundamentals', meta badge '6 lessons • 4h 20m', kebab menu (options: Rename, Reorder, Duplicate, Delete).
    - Lesson list inside Section 1 (clean draggable cards):
      - Lesson 1 (Currently Selected / Active for editing with blue/indigo highlight border):
        - Grip handle, video camera icon / thumbnail preview badge, title '1. Introduction to Excel & Workspace Setup', duration '12:30', 'Free preview' toggle switch active/ON, completion rule pill 'Auto (watch 90%)', active editing pencil indicator, delete icon button.
      - Lesson 2:
        - Grip handle, video thumbnail placeholder, title '2. Grid Navigation, Cell Referencing & Data Types', duration '18:45', 'Free preview' toggle ON, completion rule pill 'Auto (watch 90%)', edit icon, delete icon.
      - Lesson 3:
        - Grip handle, video thumbnail placeholder, title '3. Core Arithmetic & Basic Aggregations (SUM, COUNT, AVERAGE)', duration '24:10', 'Free preview' toggle OFF, completion rule pill 'Auto (watch 90%)', edit icon, delete icon.
      - Lesson 4:
        - Grip handle, document/quiz icon, title '4. Quick Check: Excel Cell Formatting & Keyboard Shortcuts', duration '15:00', quiz badge 'Interactive Quiz', completion rule pill 'Score ≥ 80%', edit/delete icons.
      - Lesson 5:
        - Grip handle, video thumbnail placeholder, title '5. Logical Functions: Nested IF, AND, OR Syntax', duration '22:15', 'Free preview' toggle OFF, completion rule pill 'Auto (watch 90%)', edit/delete icons.
      - Lesson 6:
        - Grip handle, downloadable resource icon, title '6. Section 1 Exercise Workbook & Guided Walkthrough', duration '35:00', file attachment chip 'sales_ledger_raw.xlsx', completion rule pill 'Manual Mark Complete'.
    - Bottom of Section 1: Dashed border button '+ Add lesson to this section' with options dropdown (Video lesson, Quiz, Reading material, Assignment).

  - Section 2: 'Advanced Excel Formulas & Modeling' (Collapsed state):
    - Header: Drag handle, chevron collapsed icon, title 'Section 2: Advanced Formulas & Dynamic Arrays', meta '7 lessons • 3h 10m', kebab menu.
  - Section 3: 'Power Query & Automated ETL Workflows' (Collapsed state):
    - Header: Drag handle, chevron, title 'Section 3: Power Query: Cleaning Messy Data', meta '6 lessons • 2h 45m', kebab menu.
  - Section 4: 'Executive Dashboards & VBA Macros' (Collapsed state):
    - Header: Drag handle, chevron, title 'Section 4: Executive Dashboard UI & Capstone Model', meta '7 lessons • 8h 30m', kebab menu.
  - '+ Add new section' prominent dashed border button at the bottom of the list.

  RIGHT COLUMN (40% width - Lesson Editor Drawer / Panel):
  - Sticky/Card container titled: 'Edit lesson: Introduction to Excel' with 'Lesson 1 of 26' indicator and close button.
  - Video upload dropzone card:
    - File upload state displaying 'uploaded file: 01_excel_intro_master_v3.mp4 (482 MB)'
    - Progress bar at 64% with animated striped/solid indigo fill
    - Status badge: 'Processing: transcoding 720p / 1080p stream' with spinning loader icon
    - Helper note: 'Max 2GB, MP4/MOV, direct secure AWS S3 upload • 1080p 60fps supported'
    - Action links: 'Replace video', 'Preview stream'
  - Form Fields:
    - Lesson title input: 'Introduction to Excel & Workspace Setup'
    - Lesson slug / permalink: '/courses/advanced-excel/intro-setup'
    - Description textarea with rich text formatting bar (Bold, Italic, Link, Code snippet):
      'In this foundational module, learners get familiarized with modern Excel ribbon ergonomics, grid referencing, customized quick access toolbars, and high-productivity shortcut foundations.'
    - Duration field: Auto-detected duration badge '12:30' with 'Recalculate from video' link.
    - Resource attachments section:
      - File chips:
        - [XLSX] 'intro_shortcuts_cheatsheet.xlsx' (1.2 MB) with delete cross
        - [PDF] 'excel_ribbon_architecture.pdf' (3.8 MB) with delete cross
      - '+ Attach file or download link' dashed button
    - Settings toggles:
      - 'Free preview lesson' toggle switch ON with explanatory subtext: 'Students can watch this lesson without purchasing or enrolling in the course.'
      - 'Discussion forum enabled' toggle ON ('Allow students to post Q&A on this lesson')
      - 'Downloadable offline access' toggle ON
    - Completion rule select dropdown:
      - Selected: 'Auto on 90% watched' (Options: Auto on 90% watched, Manual mark complete, Pass quiz score ≥ 80%)
    - Panel Footer Buttons:
      - 'Save lesson' solid indigo button
      - 'Cancel' light button

- Bottom Sticky Action Bar:
  - Fixed floating bar at bottom:
    - Left: Alert / warning dot icon with text: 'You have unsaved changes in Section 1 (Lesson 1 updated 2 mins ago)'
    - Right: 'Discard changes' ghost button, and 'Save draft' secondary outlined button, and 'Publish updates' solid indigo button.

Visual Style:
- Clean corporate enterprise SaaS aesthetic (Linear / Stripe / Coursera admin quality).
- Slate-50 background, pure white rounded-xl cards with subtle borders (border-slate-200), indigo-600 accents.
- Badges with clear typography, high contrast, clean Lucide style SVG icons for grips, videos, checks, file types.
